android.desc:
Find photos in your phone's gallery by describing what you remember. Search camera photos, saved pictures and screenshots without adding tags by hand.

Search photos by description
Try "dog on the beach", "mountain sunset" or "birthday cake". AI matches your words with the visual content of your indexed photos. Results depend on your library and how you describe the image.

Search text in photos and screenshots
With text recognition enabled, search words in screenshots, receipts and notes. For example, type "Espresso" to find a cafe receipt. After the text index is ready, open a matching photo to see the recognized text highlighted or copy the text. OCR finds written words; description search finds what appears in the picture.

Find videos by describing a scene
Enable video search and allow access to videos. After video indexing, describe a scene to find matching clips in your local library, then open them for playback.

On-device AI and offline search
Photo indexing, AI matching, text recognition and supported query translation run on your device. Your photos do not need to be uploaded for search. There are no ads and no app account to create. Setup and required model downloads may need an internet connection; once setup and indexing are complete, you can search offline. Analytics and crash reporting are described in the store's Data safety section and our privacy policy.

Refine a description search
Search within your results to narrow them down, adjust the similarity threshold, or sort by similarity or date.

Find similar photos and filter with Plus
With Plus, choose a photo to find visually similar pictures in your library, or share an image from your system gallery into the app to start a local image search. Plus also lets you restrict searches by album, folder or date range. Plus is an optional in-app purchase.

Getting started
Grant access to your photos and, for video search, your videos. Larger libraries take time to index for the first time. Text and video search need their own indexes and the relevant settings enabled. Supported non-English descriptions use on-device translation to English; a translation model may need to be downloaded before first use. Search covers media that the app can access and has indexed.

quotes.text: By running the OpenAI Clip model locally, "Chat Gallery" Android App can search for photos on your device based on descriptions. Just enter keywords, and you'll immediately find the images you're looking for. For instance, imagine a photo scenario like "watching the sunrise at the beach". Simply input the corresponding description to quickly locate it. "Chat Gallery" won't upload your photos to the cloud; it just calculates the image index during its initial run. The app recognizes people, animals, colors, weather, locations, and even the emotions conveyed in the photos.Download Link: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.cooke.picklight
